2nd Answers to the Request to Madam Wong Pik Kiu  
Independent Committee in relation to the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po dated 28 April 2026

A. 前言

1. 本人現回覆 2026 年 4 月 28 日大埔宏福苑火災成立的獨立委員會（「委員會」）的律師代表羅文錦律師樓致本人代表律師的信函，以及其後於 2026 年 5 月 6 日發出之補充提問信函。本人在整理手上文件後，現回覆委員會查詢如下。

2. 本回覆乃基於本人記憶及現時可掌握的有限文件而作出。鑒於當時本人任職法團顧問至今已有一段時間，且自 2024 年 9 月 6 日已卸任該職，倘若日後有進一步的文件或資料出現，本人保留包括但不限於補充、修訂或澄清本文回覆之一切權利。

3. 本人已在 2026 年 4 月 8 日書面回覆委員會的第一輪提問及提供相關附件。此書面回覆為回應委員會於 2026 年 4 月 28 日及 5 月 6 日的第二輪提問。

4. 本文會先將委員會的問題逐一列出，然後本人作出回覆。

問題 1 Provide her response to the allegations made by the various witnesses as set out therein, including in particular:

1.1 Please describe and clarify your client’s role in collecting proxies from the residents of Wang Fuk Court and the steps taken by your client and/or her team members to:

1.1.1 obtain the proxies from the residents. Please describe and explain the purpose, the time and place in which the proxies were obtained and stating the date(s) of the AGMs, EGMs and/or other meetings of the owners for which the proxies were sought;

1.1.2 verify the identity of the residents providing the proxies; and

1.1.3 ascertain and ensure that instructions of the residents in relation to casting of votes would be followed.

1.2 Confirm the number of proxies your client (and/or her team) have obtained in relation to each AGM, EGM and/or other meetings of the owners and explain how the proxy votes were exercised on each occasion.

1.3 Provide all relevant records and documentation in support of your answers above.
